rainbow_line.note: A toll road: the summit park is reached by car, or by the seasonal Gokoichi bus (ゴコイチバス, run by Fukui Railway) from JR Mikata station on weekends and holidays, July to November. That bus is the only open timetable here, and no open timetable links it to Fukui Station: JR Obama Line trains (Mikata, Kiyama) are not open data.
rainbow_line.note_ja: 有料道路のため、山頂公園へは車か、季節運行のゴコイチバス（福井鉄道、7〜11月の土日祝）で。オープンな時刻表はこのバスだけで、福井駅とつながる時刻表はない（JR小浜線の三方・気山駅はオープンデータでない）。
